title: Polytrades
subtitle: Freelance • 2026
shortDescription: Internal estimating platform that takes invitations to bid from the inbox to a finished proposal, with AI intake and automated electrical takeoff.
fullDescription: Polytrades is an internal platform for electrical estimating. It reads invitations to bid from the company inboxes with LLMs, pulls the plan documents, and tracks every bid through review, takeoff and pricing. Its electrical takeoff uses OCR and computer vision to detect fixtures, associate circuits and calculate material quantities from construction plans. Priced projects become proposals for each bidding company, built from that company's own template.
screenshotNote: Taken from a scrubbed build of the internal platform. Companies, people, emails, projects and amounts are placeholder data, and the plan sheet in the takeoff view is a publicly available electrical drawing.

contributions.detail: Worked on the interface across the platform.
Built the automated electrical takeoff that reads plan sheets with OCR and computer vision.
Automated steps inside the takeoff: detecting fixtures, associating circuits and calculating material quantities.
Worked on turning a priced project into proposals: bidders, scope and PDF output.
Modeled and architected the database behind projects, takeoffs and proposals, with proper relationships between them and query optimizations to keep the app fast.

title: Wheatland Health Internal System
subtitle: Freelance • 2026
shortDescription: HIPAA-compliant staff operations platform for a Florida home health agency, from patient intake and insurance to scheduling.
fullDescription: A HIPAA-compliant staff operations platform for a Florida home health agency that sends nurses and therapists to patients' homes. It replaces the agency's old system as the office's command center: intake of new referrals, insurance eligibility and authorization, visit scheduling, and the clinical review, QA, billing and HR work around them.
screenshotNote: I am not permitted to show the system.

contributions.detail: Built a visual map of the areas the agency serves, showing where its patients are from live data. Each pin previews the patient's key personal and medical details.
Built staffing suggestions that rank caregivers for each patient ahead of their scheduled visit.
Ranks caregivers on whether they have cared for that patient before, their expertise, their utilization and schedule for that day, travel distance and the area's usual traffic.

title: MedBid
subtitle: Freelance • 2026
shortDescription: Healthcare marketplace for California and Nevada that connects patients with verified providers through competitive bidding.
fullDescription: A healthcare marketplace for patients in California and Nevada. Verified providers bid on patient requests, which simplifies finding care, comparing prices, scheduling and paying. It includes HIPAA-aware workflows for provider credential checks, patient requests, appointments and escrow-based payments.

title: Hearsona
subtitle: Thesis Project • 2025–2026
shortDescription: Human-in-the-loop generative AI tool that creates personalized audio cues from text and user-set parameters.
fullDescription: A human-in-the-loop generative AI tool that lets users co-create personalized audio cues. An LLM-orchestrated pipeline uses Mistral 7B for intent reasoning and AudioLDM2 for synthesis, and users refine each result through natural-language feedback and fine-grained parameters until the cue matches their own associations. O-VR Hear Space, the VR study built alongside it, connects to Hearsona through its API.

contributions.detail: Architected the LLM orchestration pipeline, including the human-in-the-loop refinement.
Harnessed the models to generate audio from text prompts and user-set parameters.
Built the APIs.

title: O-VR Hear Space
subtitle: Thesis Project • 2025
shortDescription: VR environment that tests personalized spatial audio for object localization, connected to Hearsona for its audio cues.
fullDescription: A Unity and Meta XR study of how cognitive-level personalization in spatial audio affects object localization in virtual reality. Participants search for sound sources in a 3D environment, and cue effectiveness is measured by search time and in-VR questionnaires: NASA-TLX for workload and UEQ-S for user experience. The environment connects to Hearsona through an API to use its personalized audio cues.

contributions.detail: Modelled the virtual environment.
Built the interactive logic between the user and the 3D world.
Wrote the logic for the localization task criteria.
Connected the VR environment to Hearsona through its API.

title: Lexson System
subtitle: Client-Based Project • 2024
shortDescription: Inventory and billing system that replaced manual records with real-time stock tracking and order-to-invoice automation.
fullDescription: A custom inventory and billing system for a client business, replacing manual record-keeping with a centralized database. It automates the flow from stock monitoring and order fulfillment to invoicing, which cut data entry errors and gave the client real-time visibility into stock and finances.

contributions.detail: Built the backend, including the order-to-billing automation.
Modeled and architected the central database for stock, orders and billing, with proper relationships and optimized queries for real-time stock tracking and financial reporting.
